title: Dont bother
text:
Dont bother. Sent back - wouldnt open or enlarge worth a hoot.
Who needs the aggravation. Plus> would they open to get clean in dishwasher? They would come out dripping too. Nope. I use glass with their own lids.

product_metadata.title: Wentworth 5 Piece Silicone Bowl Covers
features: Pure silicone covers expand to fit a variety of shapes and sizes of containers for an airtight fit
2 sizes to fit containers 9 to 12 inches in diameter
description: Cuisine Magic 5 Piece Silicone Flexible Bowl Cover Set is made from temperature resistant silicone that resists temperatures from -40F to 446F degrees. Pure unbreakable food grade silicone keeps its shape forever. Set includes 3 small covers and 2 medium covers. Stretches to fit containers of various sizes.
